name: sahayak
description: Sahayak: OPD intake, triage, queue and doctor pre-brief for Indian government hospitals. frontend/ (React, JavaScript) + backend/ (Node, JavaScript).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:all" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.backend:infra: cd backend && docker compose up -d postgres pgbouncer redis-core redis-cache objectstore
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend run test:unit
